# ADO

## Redundant ado context file ref
- Always reference the persistent context file for project information.
    - persistent_ado_context.md = 'context\persistent_ado_context.md'

## Safe guards
- Validate all operations against the context before execution.
- Ask the user for confirmation before making changes.

## User preferences
- Include the work item name as the hyperlink text.
- Include the work item ID in parentheses after the hyperlink text.
